title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-03 10:26:54 最新章节：第1013章 力战古神
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
【本故事纯属虚构，如有雷同纯属巧合，高武虚幻，请勿模仿，因为虚幻宇宙诸天，有许多恐怖惊悚画面，胆小慎入】
‘忭哒’
‘轰隆隆’
宇宙诸天电闪雷鸣，
天体黑压压的风云际荡，
诸天万界如在筛糠。
万界之外天域，无边无际的浩瀚，没有日月星辰，没有万物生灵，放眼望去幽暗朦胧，黑气弥漫，神级以下一切踏入必被黑气焚毁，
这里便是包裹诸天万界的；未知界域！
历来处于禁止的未知界域，
被一前一后的神魔进入打破沉寂，
他们从踏进未知界域便开始释放无边法力，
身体膨胀到星球大小，
一个意念，星球爆炸，
一掌推出，如刮起世纪空寂风，满天星辰乱晃，甚至坠落。
又有神魔踏入未知界域，
他们互相攻击，
法力演化的闪电如银蛇·黑龙，在幽暗界域空间乱舞，它们如同万丈巨龙互相碰撞吞噬，随便一条爆发的能量都能摧毁星球。
神魔不断的进入界域，一团团法力光球打出，
光球碰撞的大爆炸，如同巨大璀璨的烟花在幽暗界域到处燃放，发出亿丈光芒。
最后，未知界域神魔乱舞，开启大乱斗，星海如在沸腾，到处都是连天大爆炸。

···
神魔大战，万界遭殃，
原本多姿多彩的宇宙诸天，被神魔大战释放的无边法力波及，
法力能量如同飓风海浪席卷过诸天万界天体，
绞碎一切，摧毁一切···
‘忭哒’
‘轰隆隆’
万界星域在一波波电光交错大爆炸中，遭受毁天灭地的破坏，
天体在崩塌，星体在爆裂。
神魔大战就是在遥远的未知界域大乱战，诸天万界都深受其害，生灵涂炭！
万界在无数次超级大爆炸中坠入暗黑
···
一个个数万年后，
毁天灭地的大爆炸逐渐平息。
原本多姿多彩的诸天万界，被灰雾笼罩，
日月星辰仍然运行不稳，忽明忽暗，天气极端，
各界灾害连年，百废待兴，生灵万不存一。
content_en:
[This story is purely fictitious. Any similarities are purely coincidental. Please do not imitate the high martial arts and illusions, because there are many terrifying and horrifying scenes in the illusory universe, so be cautious if you are timid.]
‘忭达’
'Rumble'
Lightning flashes and thunder rumbles across the universe,
The sky is dark and filled with stormy clouds,
The heavens and the world are like sifting chaff.
The sky beyond the world is boundless and vast. There are no sun, moon, stars, or all living things. It is dark and hazy, filled with black energy. Everything below the god level will be burned by the black energy.
This is the unknown realm that encompasses all heavens and realms!
Always in the forbidden unknown realm,
The silence was broken by the entry of gods and demons one after another,
They began to release boundless magic power as soon as they stepped into the unknown realm.
The body expands to the size of a planet,
One thought, the planet exploded,
Pushing it out with one palm, it was like a century-long empty wind blowing, and the stars in the sky were shaking and even falling.
Another god and demon stepped into the unknown realm,
They attack each other,
The lightning evolved by mana is like a silver snake or a black dragon, dancing wildly in the space of the dark realm. They are like giant dragons colliding and devouring each other. Any burst of energy can destroy the planet.
Gods and demons continue to enter the realm, and balls of mana light are shot out.
The big explosion caused by the collision of light balls was like huge bright fireworks that were set off everywhere in the dark realm, emitting billions of rays of light.
Finally, the gods and demons in the unknown realm danced wildly, starting a huge battle. The sea of ​​stars seemed to be boiling, and there were huge explosions everywhere.
···
The war between gods and demons brings disaster to all worlds.
The originally colorful universe and heavens were affected by the boundless mana released by the war between gods and demons.
Mana energy is like hurricane waves sweeping through the heavens and celestial bodies in all realms,
Crush everything, destroy everything...
‘忭达’
'Rumble'
The Star Realm of Ten Thousand Realms was devastated by waves of lightning and lightning.
Celestial bodies are collapsing and stars are exploding.
The war between gods and demons is a chaotic war in a distant unknown realm. All the heavens and all realms are deeply affected by it, and all living beings are in ruins!
All worlds fell into darkness in countless super explosions
···
Tens of thousands of years later,
The huge explosion that destroyed the world gradually subsided.
The originally colorful world was shrouded in gray mist.
The sun, moon and stars still move erratically, flickering in and out, and the weather is extreme.
Disasters from all walks of life have been occurring year after year, with hundreds of wastes waiting to be renovated, and not even a single soul left.
